task.description:
Run the official TEST-RUNNER pass for ISS-502. TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (step 3b) already got a corroborating 4/4 pass from the compiled test binary directly, but flagged a MINOR infra issue: the ambient BPM_TEST_DB_URL in this environment points at port 5433, while the actually-running r-co-db_test-1 container maps host port 5434 (docker-compose.yml declares 5433:5432 but the live container drifted). Resolve the port mismatch first (check `docker ps` for the real port mapping and export BPM_TEST_DB_URL to match, or restart/recreate the db_test container to match docker-compose.yml — your choice, whichever is less disruptive to any other work using that container) before running tests. Do not merge or cherry-pick from feature/registry-consolidation to fix this — that branch has an unrelated, not-yet-merged port-collision fix (commit 8eb85ba) that is out of scope for this run; just make the env var and the running container agree for this test session.

Then run: zig build (full project, must exit 0, zero error-set warnings), zig build test (full unit suite), and the ISS-502 integration test specifically (zig build test-integration-iss502, or run the compiled test binary directly if the zig build wrapper's progress-tree renderer misrenders — check real exit code and binary stdout, not just the wrapper's tree display, per TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's note). Also run test-integration-tm to confirm no regression on the related fresh-DB-bootstrap fix from earlier in this run.

Write the test report to tests/reports/report-<date>-WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730.yaml per the test guide format.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 ISS-502 test cases (TC-ISS502-01..04) PASS with a real, verified exit code

ISS-502 integration test verified three independent ways: (1) zig build test-integration-iss502 --summary all showed 'Build Summary: 5/5 steps succeeded; 4/4 tests passed' despite interleaved POSTGRES ERROR noise (expected idempotent-setup probing + the deliberate PK-conflict scenario that IS TC-ISS502-03) and a misleading 'failed command' line from the Zig 0.16.0-dev progress-tree renderer quirk; (2) isolated re-run redirecting all output to a log file with explicit exit-code capture in the same statement confirmed REAL_EXIT_CODE:0; (3) located and ran the compiled test.exe directly with BPM_TEST_DB_URL/BPM_MIGRATIONS_DIR set explicitly — unambiguous stdout '1/4 TC-ISS502-01 ... OK', '2/4 TC-ISS502-02 ... OK', '3/4 TC-ISS502-03 ... OK', '4/4 TC-ISS502-04 ... OK', 'All 4 tests passed.', BINARY_EXIT:0. test-integration-tm regression check: 14/14 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 — no regression from the earlier fresh-DB-bootstrap fix in this run. Benchmark env precheck (zig build bench) was clean: all 5 NFR checks passed, no BPM_DB_URL/setup errors. Keycloak health check on localhost:8081/health/ready was unreachable (container has no host port mapping in current docker state) — noted as MINOR per standard precheck, not a blocker since ISS-502 has no auth/Keycloak dependency.
